# DailyViewPage

A read-only view of one day: radio plays per show for "Radio plays: Sat 24 Oct", with 24-hour times, which plays were new to the library, and a now line in the…

`SongNodes.DailyViewPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.DailyViewPage date="…" shows={…} dataFrom="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.DailyViewPage" date="…" shows="{{…}}" data-from="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (DailyViewPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` * | `string` | The day shown (Melbourne). |
| `shows` * | `ShowDay[]` | Groups in start-time order. |
| `dataFrom` * | `string` | When the plays were last fetched. |
| `now` * | `string` | Current time; the now line shows only when date is today. |
| `state` * | `"loading" \| "ready" \| "refreshing" \| "empty" \| "error" \| "offline"` | Data state. |
| `onDayChange` * | `(date: IsoDate) => void` | Day navigation ([ and ]); next is disabled on today. |

### ShowDay

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `show` * | `string` | Show name as the station writes it ("PBS Soul Time"). |
| `slot` * | `string` | Slot, 24-hour ("13:00–15:00"). |
| `onAir` | `boolean` | True while the show is on air; draws the now line after the last play. |
| `plays` * | `RadioPlay[]` | Plays in air order. |
